import json, random, sys
rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]))
mode = sys.argv[2]

C=8; E=4; W=16; K=5; S=256; F=8
cfg = {"slots":S,"window":W,"idle_timeout":10**12,"len_quantum":1,"gap_quantum":1,
 "rate_num":1000000,"rate_den":1,"bucket_capacity":512,"initial_tokens":512,
 "pending_capacity":512,"lanes":4,"service":[1000000]*C,"fallback":0,
 "time_edges":[0],"count_edges":[0],"probability":[[65536]]}
mdl = {"classes":C,"embedding_dim":E,
 "length_embedding":[[rng.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],
 "gap_embedding":[[rng.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],
 "kernel":K,
 "conv_weights":[[[rng.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(2*E)] for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(F)],
 "conv_bias":[rng.randint(-2**31,2**31-1) for _ in range(F)],
 "conv_shift":[16]*F,
 "dense_weights":[[rng.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(F)] for _ in range(C)],
 "dense_bias":[rng.randint(-2**31,2**31-1) for _ in range(C)]}
if mode=="few":
    n=8
    conns=[{"id":"conn%04d"%i,"slot":i,"label":rng.randint(0,C-1),"split":"dev" if i%2 else "eval"} for i in range(n)]
else:
    n=2048
    conns=[{"id":"conn%04d"%i,"slot":i%256,"label":rng.randint(0,C-1),"split":"dev" if i%2 else "eval"} for i in range(n)]

    pkts.append({"time":t,"connection":conns[i%n]["id"],"length":rng.randint(0,65535),"draw":0})
